gloss: to look old and worn; to become shabby with age

definitions.gloss: to look old and worn; to become shabby with age
definitions.explanation: For objects or buildings to show visible signs of age and deterioration.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}ぼけた{本|ほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Old, worn books are lined up.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{古|ふる}ぼけてしまった。
examples.english: This building has become completely run-down.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}ぼけた⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{写|うつ}っていた→写る：11494_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: In the faded old photograph, my grandmother's figure from her younger days was captured.

notes:
A descriptive verb that conveys the appearance of age and wear on physical objects. Composed of ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧ (old) and ⟦ぼける→ぼける：07840_bokeru⟧ (to become blurred/faded). Most often appears in the past participle form {古|ふる}ぼけた as a modifier before nouns. It can carry a nostalgic or atmospheric tone, or simply describe decay.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古|ふる}ぼけた⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a run-down house
- {古|ふる}ぼけた⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: a faded old photograph
- {古|ふる}ぼけた{本|ほん}: a worn old book
- {古|ふる}ぼけた⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧: a weathered old sign

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{古|ふる}びる→古びる：11950_furubiru⟧: to grow old; to show age — similar meaning but slightly more neutral, less emphasis on shabbiness
- ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deteriorate with age — a formal term used for infrastructure, buildings, and equipment
- ⟦くたびれる→くたびれる：28755_kutabireru⟧: to be worn out — focuses on being tired or used up, applies to clothes and people
